queries.cohesion_regulations:
PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

            SELECT DISTINCT ?work ?celex ?title ?date ?type WHERE {
                ?work cdm:resource_legal_id_celex ?celex .
                ?work cdm:work_date_document ?date .
                ?work cdm:work_title ?title .
                OPTIONAL { ?work cdm:resource_legal_type ?type . }

                FILTER(
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "Struktur") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "Kohäsion") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "EFRE") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "ESF") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "2021/1060") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "2021/1058") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "1303/2013") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "regionale Entwicklung")
                )
                FILTER(LANG(?title) = "de")
            }
            ORDER BY DESC(?date)
            LIMIT 200
queries.delegated_regulations:
PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

            SELECT DISTINCT ?work ?celex ?title ?date WHERE {
                ?work cdm:resource_legal_id_celex ?celex .
                ?work cdm:work_date_document ?date .
                ?work cdm:work_title ?title .

                FILTER(
                    CONTAINS(STR(?celex), "32021") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?celex), "32022") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?celex), "32023") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?celex), "32024")
                )
                FILTER(
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "Delegierte") &&
                    (
                        CONTAINS(STR(?title), "1060") ||
                        CONTAINS(STR(?title), "1058") ||
                        CONTAINS(STR(?title), "Struktur") ||
                        CONTAINS(STR(?title), "Kohäsion")
                    )
                )
                FILTER(LANG(?title) = "de")
            }
            ORDER BY DESC(?date)
            LIMIT 100

eurlex.update_query_template:
PREFIX cdm: <http://publications.europa.eu/ontology/cdm#>
            PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

            SELECT DISTINCT ?work ?celex ?title ?date WHERE {
                ?work cdm:resource_legal_id_celex ?celex .
                ?work cdm:work_date_document ?date .
                ?work cdm:work_title ?title .

                FILTER(?date >= "{since}"^^xsd:date)
                FILTER(
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "Struktur") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "Kohäsion") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "EFRE") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "ESF") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "2021/1060") ||
                    CONTAINS(STR(?title), "1303/2013")
                )
                FILTER(LANG(?title) = "de")
            }
            ORDER BY DESC(?date)
            LIMIT 50
